newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RTRS-Maintenance slated for Australia's Griffin.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Maintenance slated for Australia's Griffin.

text.p: The 70,000 barrels-per-day Griffin crude field offshore Australia will be shut down for maintenance for six weeks starting April 1, equity sources said on Monday.
The field is operated by Broken Hill Pty Ltd, which holds a 45 percent stake. Mobil Corp. of the U.S. holds 35 percent and Inpex Alpha Ltd the remaining 20 percent.
Griffin was shut down in December and again in January because of cyclones, which forced the floating production vessel to disconnect and move away from the path of the storms.
Traders said there were no more March barrels of Griffin available on the market, so that no further spot barrels would be available until around mid-May.
